996666925/ra2-map-editor.description: A Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge map editor for VERA20k
996666925/ra2-map-editor.body:
# YR Map Editor

A map editor for *Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge* made for [VERA20k](https://github.com/YuriPlanet/vera20k), built with Rust, egui and wgpu.

It covers the full workflow, from terrain and object editing and mission creation to saving, playtesting and map publishing. The editor requires you to provide your own legally obtained game assets; the repository does not include any game assets.

[Quick Start](#快速开始) · [User Guide](https://github.com/996666925/ra2-map-editor/blob/HEAD/docs/user-guide.md) · [Command Line and Batch Processing](https://github.com/996666925/ra2-map-editor/blob/HEAD/docs/cli.md) · [Development and Verification](https://github.com/996666925/ra2-map-editor/blob/HEAD/docs/development.md) · [Mission Scripts](https://github.com/996666925/ra2-map-editor/blob/HEAD/examples/missions/README.md)

## What it can do

| Area | Main capabilities |
| --- | --- |
| Map creation | Six environments; random maps with configurable seed, terrain, water, mountains, resources and vegetation; 2–30 player start positions |
| Terrain painting | Standalone frame display and 2D flattening, sub-tiles and full templates, rectangle-select tile fill, fill, height, LAT transitions, ramps, cliffs, plateaus, roads, shorelines and bridges |
| Tunnel editing | Draw, view, redraw and delete engine `[Tubes]` paths; eight-direction routing with undo and redo |
| Object editing | Buildings, vehicles, infantry, aircraft, trees, stains, overlays and start points; SHP/VXL appearance preview and drag-to-paint |
| Area operations | Select by layer, copy, cut, paste, move, delete, clone, plus whole-stroke undo and redo |
| Mission creation | Houses, triggers, Tag/CellTag, variables, task forces, scripts, teams, base nodes and AI triggers; TypeScript mission scripts |
| Map settings | Name, size, playable area, base lighting and crate rules |
| Saving and delivery | Background saving, backups, auto-recovery, embedded preview, PNG export, standalone VERA20k playtesting, campaign directory and mission package publishing |
| Mods and automation | Asset configuration, publish presets, and map validation, image export and batch publishing without a window or GPU |

The six environments are `TEMPERATE`, `SNOW`, `URBAN`, `NEWURBAN`, `DESERT` and `LUNAR`; random maps support five of them, excluding LUNAR.

LanYangYang-114/fleece-render.description: Minecraft player model rendering engine written in Rust | Minecraft player model rendering engine written in Rust
LanYangYang-114/fleece-render.body:
# Fleece Render

Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/LanYangYang-114/fleece-render/blob/HEAD/README_en.md)

Minecraft player model rendering engine written in Rust

## Features

- **3D full-body image**: Supports classic and slim models. Can render a cape or elytra, and optionally shows a name tag. Can output a front view, a back view, or a combined front-and-back image, with transparent background support.
- **2D avatar**: Outputs a 64×64 PNG with transparent background support.
- **Dual-layer skin**: Both the 3D full-body image and the 2D avatar enable the outer skin layer by default. You can also render only the base layer.
- **Multiple inputs**: Skins can be fetched by player name or UUID from Mojang or LittleSkin. Skin textures can also be provided via URL, a server-local file, Base64, a data URL, or image bytes.

## Examples

3D full body

```plain
GET http://127.0.0.1:57680/mojang/image/both
    ?name=LanYangYang_CN
    &style=3d
    &transparent=true
    &showName=false
```

2D avatar

```plain
GET http://127.0.0.1:57680/mojang/image/front
    ?name=LanYangYang_CN
    &style=avatar
    &transparent=true
```

## Quick Start

### Build from source

Follow the [deployment guide](https://github.com/LanYangYang-114/fleece-render/blob/HEAD/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md#从源码运行) to set up the Rust toolchain, then build and start the service from the repository root:

```sh
cargo run --release --locked -p fleece-render-server --bin fleece-render -- --host 127.0.0.1
```

### Deploy with Docker

Use the prebuilt image from GitHub Container Registry. No need to download the source:

```sh
docker run --pull=always -d --name fleece-render -p 127.0.0.1:57680:57680 ghcr.io/lanyangyang-114/fleece-render:latest
```

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

wgzhao/addax-admin.description: Addax Admin is a web-based management console for Addax ETL jobs, offering task scheduling, monitoring, and data management with a Vue 3 frontend and Spring Boot backend.
wgzhao/addax-admin.body:
# Addax Admin

Addax Admin is a modern, enterprise-grade ETL management and monitoring console built for the Addax ETL engine. The project is organized as a monorepo, containing a complete backend API service and a frontend management interface. It aims to provide a one-stop operations experience covering job configuration, scheduled execution, runtime monitoring, and log auditing.

Core goal: make it easier for data engineers and operations staff to manage Addax jobs, observe runtime status, tune concurrency and retry policies, and ensure high availability and concurrency control in multi-node deployments.

---

## Interface Preview

The following are system interface screenshots (demo data) to help you quickly understand the interface and feature coverage:

For more page screenshots, see [screenshots/](https://github.com/wgzhao/addax-admin/blob/HEAD/screenshots/).

## Directory Structure (Brief)

```text
addax-admin/
├── backend/                 # Spring Boot 4 backend service (API, scheduling, persistence, queues and leases)
├── frontend/                # Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript + Vuetify admin interface
├── docs/                    # Installation and usage manual, ADRs, testing and security docs
├── scripts/                 # Deployment and operations scripts (DB initialization, systemd service templates, etc.)
└── README.md                # This document
```

## Main Components

- Addax Admin Backend: A Spring Boot implementation responsible for task persistence (PostgreSQL), dispatch logic, database leases, Redis leader election and heartbeat, permissions and JWT, scheduling (cron/periodic), and more.
- Addax Admin Frontend: A single-page application built with Vue 3 + Vuetify, providing task configuration, ODS table management, log viewing, real-time monitoring, and alert configuration.
- Database initialization: [scripts/schema.sql](https://github.com/wgzhao/addax-admin/blob/HEAD/scripts/schema.sql) and [scripts/data.sql](https://github.com/wgzhao/addax-admin/blob/HEAD/scripts/data.sql) provide the database schema and default data. They are packaged into the backend jar at build time, and an empty database is automatically initialized on the application's first startup.

---

## Highlights and Features

- Hybrid concurrency control architecture: DB-persisted queue + Redis leader election and task dispatch + database leases, balancing reliability, auditability, and fault recovery.
